mapper.sql: id, document_id, status, total_blocks, processed_blocks, requirement_count, issue_count, message, started_at, finished_at, created_by, extractor
mapper.select: select from parse_run where document_id = #{documentId} order by started_at desc
mapper.insert: insert into parse_run (id, document_id, status, total_blocks, processed_blocks, requirement_count, issue_count, message, started_at, finished_at, created_by, extractor) values (#{id}, #{documentId}, #{status}, #{totalBlocks}, #{processedBlocks}, #{requirementCount}, #{issueCount}, #{message}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{extractor})
mapper.update: update parse_run set extractor = #{extractor}, status = #{status}, total_blocks = #{totalBlocks}, processed_blocks = #{processedBlocks}, requirement_count = #{requirementCount}, issue_count = #{issueCount}, message = #{message}, started_at = #{startedAt}, finished_at = #{finishedAt} where id = #{id}
